title: 🏥 Danville VA Healthcare Jobs with Multiple RN & CNA Openings - NewsBreak
text:
7 hours ago Danville’s healthcare scene is busy and hiring across hospitals, travel agencies, and senior living. Good mix of bedside care, therapy, and contract roles if you’re ready for a change.
CNA/PCA (Resident Care Associate) – 2nd Shift Employer: Commonwealth Senior Living Location: Danville, VA (1111 Main St.) Type: Full-time Pay: $15–$19/hour Shift: 3pm–11pm (2nd shift)
This role supports seniors in Assisted Living/Memory Care with daily activities and care plans. No prior experience required if you’re compassionate and willing to get certified; you can even stop by their Walk-In Wednesday hiring hours every Wednesday, 10am–12pm. Recreational Therapist Employer: Sovah Health – Danville Location: Danville, VA Type: Full-time Pay: $17.16–$20.38/hour
This role plans and leads group and one-on-one therapeutic recreation sessions in a 250-bed acute care hospital. Great fit if you have a bachelor’s in therapeutic recreation/psych or related field plus CTRS and want solid benefits and career growth. Registered Nurse (RN) – Medical/Surgical Nights Employer: Sovah Health – Danville Location: Danville, VA Type: Part-time Pay: $33.31–$44.97/hour Bonus: Up to $20,000 sign-on (eligibility stated) Schedule: Three 12-hour shifts, 7pm–7am
Work on a 24-bed Med/Surg unit with a 1:6 nurse-to-patient ratio and strong team support. Ideal if you have a Virginia or compact RN license and want part-time night shifts with solid benefits and tuition/loan assistance options. Local Contract Nurse RN – OR (Operating Room) Employer: Host Healthcare, Inc. Location: Danville, VA Type: Local contract (13 weeks) Pay: $50–$54/hour Schedule: 36 hrs/week, 12-hour day shifts
Short-term OR RN contract with strong travel-style benefits while staying local. Good option if you want premium pay, day shift OR work, and the perks of a travel agency without going far from home.
